title: Cross-peer DXF writer grammar and HATCH pixel-size presence reconciliation
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local source/test audit; plan refinement
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp's HATCH group-47 strict-consumer reports with Autodesk DXF/ObjectARX references
Compare HATCH/MPOLYGON DWG and DXF pixel-size conditions with the current local model and generated test
Recheck adjacent CLASS, DIMSTYLE-header, EED-length, output-string, and NOD-order peer reports against existing local owners
Refine the next bounded implementation slice without creating a new support claim or validation dependency

method.kind: Read primary project issues and Autodesk references; inspect local source, tests, and plan
method.limitations: The ACadSharp HATCH report cites peer-repository and native-produced artifacts that were not retrieved or independently inspected. Autodesk documents group-47 meaning and group-92 flags, but not a complete presence/default predicate. No local strict-consumer or native acceptance run was performed; ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.observed: Group 47 describes the pixel size used by associative and Flood-method HATCH computations; boundary group-92 bit 4 is Derived; ObjectARX defines a derived loop as generated by the boundary tracer from a picked point. The CLASS schema lists groups 0/1/2/3/90/91/280/281 and excludes 92/93. These references do not establish every group-47 presence/default combination or a special DIMSTYLE table-header contract.

sources.revision: Issue #1253 opened 2026-09-13, with follow-up 2026-09-23; issue #1282 opened 2026-10-11; pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: #1253 initially suggests omitting zero HATCH group 47, but its later comment reports an AC1032 derived-path sample where group 47 was present for path flag 92=7 and removal from all derived hatches caused TrueView rejection. This later report conflicts with the blanket initial suggestion and is not independently reproduced. #1282 documents its writer narrowing a per-APPID EED stream length to signed short: 32,768 bytes wraps while 32,764 bytes is reported to work. That is a peer implementation failure, not a format limit.

#1412 reports a C output-string buffer termination issue leading to strlen reading allocation residue and an empty-after-transform framing edge; local C++ DXF sinks use explicit string_view lengths. #1413 reports positional NOD selection loss; local generated controls already exercise a lower-handle extension dictionary ahead of the positional root. These are existing-owner cross-checks, not new local findings.

The DWG HATCH reader/writer conditions pixel-size storage on a derived path bit. Both DXF HATCH and MPOLYGON emit group 47 only when pixelSize != 0; DXF parsing stores the numeric value but no presence bit. The generated hatch_reference test has an associative type-7 derived loop with zero pixel size and expects group 47 absent, so it covers current local behavior but does not independently establish the correct producer/native presence rule. DRW_Class::write emits only documented CLASS groups. Existing EED boundary controls cover 32,767/32,768/65,535/65,536 using unsigned length and item-boundary splitting.

assessment.planImpact: Promotes the HATCH group-47 concern from a peer-only note to a source-visible cross-route conformance question inside existing 7AH/7Z. The next step reuses the current generated ASCII/Binary HATCH test owner to characterize absent, explicit-zero, and nonzero presence plus ordering/alignment. It does not impose a group-47 predicate, add a new finding, modify code/tests, change queue order, or make native/peer validation a per-slice prerequisite.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep HATCH and MPOLYGON separate and do not generate invalid Cartesian combinations of fill, associativity, path flags, and pixel-size state.
Use the existing hatch_reference_tests owner and independent raw-tag scanning; assert group-47 count/value/order, group-98 boundary, and a following-entity sentinel for ASCII and Binary DXF.
Test absent group 47 separately from explicit 47=0 because the current public model collapses the distinction.
Keep current writer behavior until a primary rule or version-pinned producer/native witness resolves presence; do not implement a rule inferred only from ACadSharp issue text.
Do not add external DWG/DXF samples or dependencies; any authored control must be generated locally from scratch.
